title: £68 is 85% of the original
caption: After 15% off, the sale price is 85% of the original, so the original is £68 ÷ 0.85 = £80, not £68 + 15%.
alt: A bar for the original price split into 85%, £68, and 15%, £12, with the whole bracketed as £80.
description: The whole bar is the original price, 100%.
The sale price, £68, is the 85% part.
So 1% is £0.80 and 100% is £80; the 15% taken off was £12.
